meta.title: Add ESLint rule for slow CSS properties that may impact GPU rendering
meta.body_summary: Add ESLint rule @remotion/slow-css-property to warn about CSS properties (boxShadow, textShadow, filter) that may slow rendering on machines without GPU; later extended to string keys and Tailwind classes.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added ESLint rule; maintainer requested extension to string keys and Tailwind; fixes provided and merged within ~3h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 355 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small-scale addition that introduces a new lint rule with tests. It fits a typical safety/performance tooling PR, and the quick merge with comment-driven scope expansion is consistent with the outcome.

review_details.concern_detail: The initial rule did not cover string literal CSS properties (e.g., 'box-shadow') nor Tailwind CSS classes that apply the same effects. Maintainer JonnyBurger requested both extensions in PR comments.
review_details.performance_claim: Warn about CSS properties that may slow down rendering on machines without a GPU.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully added and iteratively expanded an ESLint rule detection scope within the plugin ecosystem, demonstrating ability to follow incremental feedback but requiring human specification of missing cases.

detection_detail.code_reading: JonnyBurger reviewed the PR description and identified that string keys and Tailwind classes were not detected, then requested these features in comments.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Rule behavior is verified by unit tests; no runtime performance measurement needed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After each comment, Copilot added the missing detection in subsequent commits; no rollback or revert required.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new ESLint rule @remotion/slow-css-property that warns when using boxShadow, textShadow, filter CSS properties (camelCase and string keys) and corresponding Tailwind CSS classes (shadow-*, blur-*, brightness-*, etc.) in React style objects and className attributes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: index.ts was updated to export the rule and include it in the recommended config.
change_trajectory: First commit (d4af0bb): added rule implementation for camelCase properties (boxShadow, textShadow, filter) and tests.
Second commit (e4b29bb): extended rule to detect string literal CSS properties like 'box-shadow'; updated tests.
Third commit (c631da5): added Tailwind CSS class detection for slow properties (shadow-*, blur-*, etc.); expanded tests.

review_signals.summary: Requested detection of string literal CSS properties like 'box-shadow'.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added string key detection in e4b29bb.

review_signals.summary: Requested detection of Tailwind CSS classes applying the slow properties.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added Tailwind class detection in c631da5.

review_signals.summary: Posted deployment preview status for the bugs site.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial slow-css-property rule for camelCase style props.
JonnyBurger commented asking for string key support; Copilot pushed fix within minutes.
JonnyBurger then requested Tailwind class detection; Copilot added it.
PR merged without formal review ~3 hours after creation.
